text: F13.4i: K4 beats its shuffles under the table with a two-letter key, then a move. Does the effect follow K4's letters around, as a hidden message would?
K4 rotated 96 ways, reversed, and cut into shuffled blocks; three planted messages under the same cipher rotated 24 ways each.

Every rotation of every planted message stays above 95% of the shuffles; only 3 of K4's 96 rotations do. The excess belongs to K4's exact order against this search, not to a message enciphered this way.
